package com.example.data.model

import java.util.UUID

enum class ItemQuality(val displayName: String) {
    NORMAL("Normal"),
    MAGIC("Magic"),
    UNIQUE("Unique")
}

enum class EquipSlot(val displayName: String, val shortLabel: String) {
    HEAD("Head", "Helm"),
    NECK("Neck", "Amulet"),
    TORSO("Torso", "Armor"),
    LEFT_HAND("Left Hand", "Main Hand"),
    RIGHT_HAND("Right Hand", "Off Hand / Shield"),
    LEFT_RING("Left Finger", "Ring 1"),
    RIGHT_RING("Right Finger", "Ring 2")
}

data class DiabloItem(
    val id: String = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
    val name: String,
    val baseType: String,
    val quality: ItemQuality = ItemQuality.NORMAL,
    val prefix: String = "",
    val suffix: String = "",
    val durability: Int = 50,
    val maxDurability: Int = 50,
    val isIndestructible: Boolean = false,
    val charges: Int = 0,
    val maxCharges: Int = 0,
    val armorClass: Int = 0,
    val minDamage: Int = 0,
    val maxDamage: Int = 0,
    val toHitBonus: Int = 0,
    val damageBonus: Int = 0,
    val strengthReq: Int = 0,
    val magicReq: Int = 0,
    val dexterityReq: Int = 0,
    val fireResist: Int = 0,
    val lightningResist: Int = 0,
    val magicResist: Int = 0,
    val allAttributesBonus: Int = 0,
    val hitPointsBonus: Int = 0,
    val manaBonus: Int = 0,
    val extraDescription: String = "",
    val gridWidth: Int = 1,
    val gridHeight: Int = 1,
    val gridX: Int = -1,
    val gridY: Int = -1,
    val modOrigin: GameMod = GameMod.VANILLA_DIABLO,
    val recommendedClasses: List<HeroClass> = emptyList(),
    val defaultSlot: EquipSlot? = null
) {
    val fullTitle: String
        get() = when (quality) {
            ItemQuality.UNIQUE -> name
            ItemQuality.MAGIC -> {
                val pre = if (prefix.isNotBlank()) "$prefix " else ""
                val suf = if (suffix.isNotBlank()) " $suffix" else ""
                "$pre$baseType$suf".trim()
            }
            ItemQuality.NORMAL -> baseType
        }

    val inferredSlot: EquipSlot?
        get() = defaultSlot ?: when {
            baseType.contains("Helm", true) || baseType.contains("Cap", true) || baseType.contains("Crown", true) || baseType.contains("Hood", true) -> EquipSlot.HEAD
            baseType.contains("Mail", true) || baseType.contains("Plate", true) || baseType.contains("Armor", true) || baseType.contains("Robe", true) || baseType.contains("Cloak", true) -> EquipSlot.TORSO
            baseType.contains("Sword", true) || baseType.contains("Bow", true) || baseType.contains("Staff", true) || baseType.contains("Axe", true) || baseType.contains("Mace", true) || baseType.contains("Hammer", true) || baseType.contains("Cudgel", true) || baseType.contains("Dagger", true) -> EquipSlot.LEFT_HAND
            baseType.contains("Shield", true) || baseType.contains("Bulwark", true) -> EquipSlot.RIGHT_HAND
            baseType.contains("Amulet", true) || baseType.contains("Phial", true) -> EquipSlot.NECK
            baseType.contains("Ring", true) -> EquipSlot.LEFT_RING
            else -> null
        }
}

    /**
     * Returns 2-3 recommended items per slot for a given character class and active mod.
     */
    fun getProposedItemsForClassBySlot(
        heroClass: HeroClass,
        mod: GameMod = GameMod.HELLFIRE
    ): Map<EquipSlot, List<DiabloItem>> {
        val result = mutableMapOf<EquipSlot, List<DiabloItem>>()

        val eligible = FULL_ITEM_LIBRARY.filter { item ->
            // Mod compatibility: Vanilla items work in all; mod items work when that mod is active
            val modMatch = when (item.modOrigin) {
                GameMod.VANILLA_DIABLO -> true
                GameMod.HELLFIRE -> mod != GameMod.VANILLA_DIABLO
                GameMod.MIDDLE_EARTH -> mod == GameMod.MIDDLE_EARTH
                GameMod.VKD_MOD -> mod == GameMod.VKD_MOD
            }
            modMatch
        }

        EquipSlot.entries.forEach { slot ->
            val slotItems = eligible.filter { item ->
                val matchesSlot = item.inferredSlot == slot || item.defaultSlot == slot
                val isRecommended = item.recommendedClasses.contains(heroClass) || item.recommendedClasses.isEmpty()
                matchesSlot && isRecommended
            }
            // Return top 2-3 items for this slot
            result[slot] = slotItems.take(3)
        }

        return result
    }

    val LEGENDARY_CATALOG: List<DiabloItem> = FULL_ITEM_LIBRARY

    /**
     * Returns 2-3 recommended items per slot for a given character class and active mod.
     */
    fun getProposedItemsForClassBySlot(
        heroClass: HeroClass,
        mod: GameMod = GameMod.HELLFIRE
    ): Map<EquipSlot, List<DiabloItem>> {
        val result = mutableMapOf<EquipSlot, List<DiabloItem>>()

        val eligible = FULL_ITEM_LIBRARY.filter { item ->
            // Mod compatibility: Vanilla items work in all; mod items work when that mod is active
            val modMatch = when (item.modOrigin) {
                GameMod.VANILLA_DIABLO -> true
                GameMod.HELLFIRE -> mod != GameMod.VANILLA_DIABLO
                GameMod.MIDDLE_EARTH -> mod == GameMod.MIDDLE_EARTH
                GameMod.VKD_MOD -> mod == GameMod.VKD_MOD
            }
            modMatch
        }

        EquipSlot.entries.forEach { slot ->
            val slotItems = eligible.filter { item ->
                val matchesSlot = item.inferredSlot == slot || item.defaultSlot == slot
                val isRecommended = item.recommendedClasses.contains(heroClass) || item.recommendedClasses.isEmpty()
                matchesSlot && isRecommended
            }
            // Return top 2-3 items for this slot
            result[slot] = slotItems.take(3)
        }

        return result
    }

    /**
     * Returns top 6 curated items recommended for this class to showcase in quick cards.
     */
    fun getTopRecommendedItemsForClass(
        heroClass: HeroClass,
        mod: GameMod = GameMod.HELLFIRE
    ): List<DiabloItem> {
        val bySlot = getProposedItemsForClassBySlot(heroClass, mod)
        val selected = mutableListOf<DiabloItem>()

        // Take best weapon, armor, helm, shield, and jewelry
        bySlot[EquipSlot.LEFT_HAND]?.firstOrNull()?.let { selected.add(it) }
        bySlot[EquipSlot.TORSO]?.firstOrNull()?.let { selected.add(it) }
        bySlot[EquipSlot.HEAD]?.firstOrNull()?.let { selected.add(it) }
        bySlot[EquipSlot.RIGHT_HAND]?.firstOrNull()?.let { selected.add(it) }
        bySlot[EquipSlot.NECK]?.firstOrNull()?.let { selected.add(it) }
        bySlot[EquipSlot.LEFT_RING]?.firstOrNull()?.let { selected.add(it) }

        // Also add secondary choices if room
        bySlot[EquipSlot.LEFT_HAND]?.getOrNull(1)?.let { selected.add(it) }
        bySlot[EquipSlot.TORSO]?.getOrNull(1)?.let { selected.add(it) }

        return selected
    }

    /**
     * Builds a full 7-slot god-tier loadout for the specified class and mod.
     */
    fun getFullRecommendedLoadout(
        heroClass: HeroClass,
        mod: GameMod = GameMod.HELLFIRE
    ): Map<EquipSlot, DiabloItem> {
        val bySlot = getProposedItemsForClassBySlot(heroClass, mod)
        val equipment = mutableMapOf<EquipSlot, DiabloItem>()

        bySlot[EquipSlot.HEAD]?.firstOrNull()?.let { equipment[EquipSlot.HEAD] = it }
        bySlot[EquipSlot.TORSO]?.firstOrNull()?.let { equipment[EquipSlot.TORSO] = it }
        bySlot[EquipSlot.LEFT_HAND]?.firstOrNull()?.let { equipment[EquipSlot.LEFT_HAND] = it }
        bySlot[EquipSlot.RIGHT_HAND]?.firstOrNull()?.let { equipment[EquipSlot.RIGHT_HAND] = it }
        bySlot[EquipSlot.NECK]?.firstOrNull()?.let { equipment[EquipSlot.NECK] = it }
        bySlot[EquipSlot.LEFT_RING]?.firstOrNull()?.let { equipment[EquipSlot.LEFT_RING] = it }
        bySlot[EquipSlot.RIGHT_RING]?.let { rings ->
            val ring2 = rings.getOrNull(1) ?: rings.firstOrNull()
            if (ring2 != null) equipment[EquipSlot.RIGHT_RING] = ring2
        }

        return equipment
    }

    fun toJson(hero: HeroCharacter): String {
        val root = JSONObject()

        // Identity
        root.put("name", hero.name)

        root.put("unlockedHell", hero.unlockedHell)

        statsObj.put("manaShieldActive", hero.manaShieldActive)
        root.put("stats", statsObj)

        // Spells
        val spellsObj = JSONObject()
        hero.spellLevels.forEach { (spellId, level) ->
            spellsObj.put(spellId, level)
        }
        root.put("spells", spellsObj)

        // Equipment
        val equipObj = JSONObject()
        hero.equipment.forEach { (slot, item) ->
            equipObj.put(slot.name, itemToJson(item))
        }
        root.put("equipment", equipObj)

        // Inventory
        val invArray = JSONArray()

        }

        hero.belt.forEach { item ->
            if (item != null) beltArray.put(itemToJson(item)) else beltArray.put(JSONObject.NULL)

    /**
     * Serializes a HeroCharacter into the Noctonic DEADitor JSON format.
     */
    fun toJson(hero: HeroCharacter): String {
        val root = JSONObject()

        // Identity
        root.put("name", hero.name)
        root.put("class", hero.heroClass.displayName)
        root.put("level", hero.level)
        root.put("experience", hero.experience)
        root.put("gold", hero.gold)
        root.put("difficulty", hero.difficulty)
        root.put("dungeonLevel", hero.dungeonLevel)
        root.put("questsCompleted", hero.questsCompleted)

        // Multiplayer & Mod
        root.put("isMultiplayer", hero.isMultiplayer)
        root.put("multiplayerSlot", hero.multiplayerSlot)
        root.put("gameMod", hero.gameMod.name)
        root.put("unlockedNightmare", hero.unlockedNightmare)
        root.put("unlockedHell", hero.unlockedHell)
        root.put("pvpKills", hero.pvpKills)
        root.put("deaths", hero.deaths)

        // Core Stats
        val statsObj = JSONObject()
        statsObj.put("strength", hero.strength)
        statsObj.put("baseStrength", hero.baseStrength)
        statsObj.put("magic", hero.magic)
        statsObj.put("baseMagic", hero.baseMagic)
        statsObj.put("dexterity", hero.dexterity)
        statsObj.put("baseDexterity", hero.baseDexterity)
        statsObj.put("vitality", hero.vitality)
        statsObj.put("baseVitality", hero.baseVitality)
        statsObj.put("statPoints", hero.statPoints)
        statsObj.put("life", hero.life)
        statsObj.put("maxLife", hero.maxLife)
        statsObj.put("baseLife", hero.baseLife)
        statsObj.put("mana", hero.mana)
        statsObj.put("maxMana", hero.maxMana)
        statsObj.put("baseMana", hero.baseMana)
        statsObj.put("manaShieldActive", hero.manaShieldActive)
        root.put("stats", statsObj)

        // Spells
        val spellsObj = JSONObject()
        hero.spellLevels.forEach { (spellId, level) ->
            spellsObj.put(spellId, level)
        }
        root.put("spells", spellsObj)

        // Equipment
        val equipObj = JSONObject()
        hero.equipment.forEach { (slot, item) ->
            equipObj.put(slot.name, itemToJson(item))
        }
        root.put("equipment", equipObj)

        // Inventory
        val invArray = JSONArray()
        hero.inventory.forEach { item ->
            invArray.put(itemToJson(item))
        }
        root.put("inventory", invArray)

        // Belt
        val beltArray = JSONArray()
        hero.belt.forEach { item ->
            if (item != null) beltArray.put(itemToJson(item)) else beltArray.put(JSONObject.NULL)
        }
        root.put("belt", beltArray)

        return root.toString(2)
    }

    private fun itemToJson(item: DiabloItem): JSONObject {
        val obj = JSONObject()
        obj.put("id", item.id)
        obj.put("name", item.name)
        obj.put("baseType", item.baseType)
        obj.put("quality", item.quality.name)

    /**
     * Parses a Noctonic DEADitor JSON string into a HeroCharacter.
     */
    fun fromJson(jsonStr: String): HeroCharacter {
        val root = JSONObject(jsonStr)

        val name = root.optString("name", "Hero")
        val className = root.optString("class", "Warrior")
        val heroClass = HeroClass.fromString(className)
        val level = root.optInt("level", 1)
        val experience = root.optLong("experience", 0L)
        val gold = root.optLong("gold", 100L)
        val difficulty = root.optString("difficulty", "Normal")
        val dungeonLevel = root.optInt("dungeonLevel", 0)
        val questsCompleted = root.optInt("questsCompleted", 0)

        // Stats
        val statsObj = root.optJSONObject("stats")
        val strength = statsObj?.optInt("strength", heroClass.baseStrength) ?: heroClass.baseStrength
        val baseStrength = statsObj?.optInt("baseStrength", strength) ?: strength
        val magic = statsObj?.optInt("magic", heroClass.baseMagic) ?: heroClass.baseMagic
        val baseMagic = statsObj?.optInt("baseMagic", magic) ?: magic
        val dexterity = statsObj?.optInt("dexterity", heroClass.baseDexterity) ?: heroClass.baseDexterity
        val baseDexterity = statsObj?.optInt("baseDexterity", dexterity) ?: dexterity
        val vitality = statsObj?.optInt("vitality", heroClass.baseVitality) ?: heroClass.baseVitality
        val baseVitality = statsObj?.optInt("baseVitality", vitality) ?: vitality
        val statPoints = statsObj?.optInt("statPoints", 0) ?: 0

        val baseMana = statsObj?.optInt("baseMana", maxMana) ?: maxMana
        val manaShieldActive = statsObj?.optBoolean("manaShieldActive", false) ?: false

        // Spells
        val spellLevels = mutableMapOf<String, Int>()
        val spellsObj = root.optJSONObject("spells")
        if (spellsObj != null) {
            val keys = spellsObj.keys()
            while (keys.hasNext()) {
                val key = keys.next()
                spellLevels[key] = spellsObj.optInt(key, 0)
            }
        }

        // Equipment
        val equipment = mutableMapOf<EquipSlot, DiabloItem>()
        val equipObj = root.optJSONObject("equipment")
        if (equipObj != null) {
            val keys = equipObj.keys()
            while (keys.hasNext()) {
                val key = keys.next()
                val slot = runCatching { EquipSlot.valueOf(key) }.getOrNull()
                val itemJson = equipObj.optJSONObject(key)
                if (slot != null && itemJson != null) {
                    equipment[slot] = parseItem(itemJson)
                }
            }
        }

        // Inventory
        val inventory = mutableListOf<DiabloItem>()
        val invArray = root.optJSONArray("inventory")
        if (invArray != null) {
            for (i in 0 until invArray.length()) {
                val itemObj = invArray.optJSONObject(i)
                if (itemObj != null) {
                    inventory.add(parseItem(itemObj))
                }
            }
        }

        // Belt
        val belt = MutableList<DiabloItem?>(8) { null }
        val beltArray = root.optJSONArray("belt")
        if (beltArray != null) {
            for (i in 0 until minOf(8, beltArray.length())) {
                val itemObj = beltArray.optJSONObject(i)
                if (itemObj != null) {
                    belt[i] = parseItem(itemObj)
                }
            }
        }

        val isMultiplayer = root.optBoolean("isMultiplayer", false)
        val multiplayerSlot = root.optInt("multiplayerSlot", 0)
        val gameModStr = root.optString("gameMod", "HELLFIRE")
        val gameMod = runCatching { GameMod.valueOf(gameModStr) }.getOrDefault(GameMod.HELLFIRE)
        val unlockedNightmare = root.optBoolean("unlockedNightmare", true)
        val unlockedHell = root.optBoolean("unlockedHell", true)
        val pvpKills = root.optInt("pvpKills", 0)
        val deaths = root.optInt("deaths", 0)

        return HeroCharacter(
            name = name,
            heroClass = heroClass,
            level = level,
            experience = experience,
            gold = gold,
            difficulty = difficulty,
            dungeonLevel = dungeonLevel,
            isMultiplayer = isMultiplayer,
            multiplayerSlot = multiplayerSlot,
            gameMod = gameMod,
            unlockedNightmare = unlockedNightmare,
            unlockedHell = unlockedHell,
            pvpKills = pvpKills,
            deaths = deaths,
            questsCompleted = questsCompleted,
            strength = strength,
            baseStrength = baseStrength,
            magic = magic,
            baseMagic = baseMagic,
            dexterity = dexterity,
            baseDexterity = baseDexterity,
            vitality = vitality,
            baseVitality = baseVitality,
            statPoints = statPoints,
            life = life,
            maxLife = maxLife,
            baseLife = baseLife,
            mana = mana,
            maxMana = maxMana,
            baseMana = baseMana,
            manaShieldActive = manaShieldActive,
            spellLevels = spellLevels,
            equipment = equipment,
            inventory = inventory,
            belt = belt
        )
    }

    private fun parseItem(obj: JSONObject): DiabloItem {

        fun fromIndex(index: Int): HeroClass {

            GameMod.VKD_MOD -> when (this) {

    }
